findings.entity: dark olive on the jar floor at the start of the first pour
findings.description: At 00:00.50 a blurred dark-purple olive is already lying on the jar's floor. The pouring bowl holds only green olives, and the first green olive is only just tipping off the bowl's lip, so nothing has fallen yet. Nothing was in the jar at 00:00.25. The olive arrives with no visible drop and is not the color of anything being poured.

Between 00:01.00 (three green olives in the jar) and 00:01.75 (about 12 olives, about five of them dark purple), the jar fills much faster than the single-file trickle of green olives from the bowl allows. Dark olives keep piling up even though the poured stream is green only, so the result does not match its cause in quantity or color.

findings.entity: glass pouring bowl contents after emptying
findings.description: From 00:08.50 to 00:09.25 the bowl is turned upside down and visibly empty over the jar. At 00:09.75 the same bowl, still held overhead, contains green olives again, with no scoop or refill action in between.
